pages.heading: Moderation, reports and ap...
pages.body: Staff review suspected rule violations, safety concerns, and technical problems. Staff do not decide who deserved to win a feud, negotiate peace, require apologies, or compensate players for permitted losses. Use the designated

pages.heading: Moderation, reports and ap...
pages.body: private reporting route for rule violations and sensitive evidence. Report the behavior, the players involved, the approximate time and timezone, the dimension and coordinates when relevant, and any available evidence.

pages.heading: Moderation, reports and ap...
pages.body: You do not need to identify an exact rule number to report a safety concern. Rollbacks and compensation are reserved for confirmed prohibited activity or technical failures when recovery is feasible. Recovery is not

pages.heading: Moderation, reports and ap...
pages.body: guaranteed. Enforcement depends on evidence and severity. Minor, correctable violations may receive a warning; repeated or serious violations may receive restrictions or bans. Serious misconduct can result in immediate action without a

pages.heading: Moderation, reports and ap...
pages.body: warning. An accusation alone is not proof. One appeal per decision may identify a factual mistake, relevant new evidence, or a misapplied rule. Ordinary disagreement does not require repeated reviews. Genuinely new

pages.heading: Moderation, reports and ap...
pages.body: information can still be added to the existing case. Supporter status, friendships, time played, and owner participation do not change the rules. An owner directly involved in a dispute should not be its sole decision-maker.

pages.heading: Moderation, reports and ap...
pages.body: Genuine policy ambiguities will normally be clarified publicly for future play rather than resolved by inventing a new rule after the event. $(l:https://beautyinblocks.com/form.html#private-reports)Check private reporting availability$(/l) .
